feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: American democracy was a big winner in the midterms
entry.summary: Results are still outstanding House and Senate races but political scientists say one of the big winners in the mid-terms is American democracy itself.

entry.title: What to know about Gina Hinojosa, Texas' first Latina governor-elect
entry.summary: Gina Hinojosa, state representative from the Rio Grande Valley whose legislative priority has been boosting the public education system, will become the first Latina governor of Texas.

entry.title: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff
entry.summary: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles is being replaced by Stephen Miller, President Trump said Friday. The change comes after Republicans were swept out of power in the midterm elections.

entry.title: The economy propelled Democrats to victory. What can they actually do about it?
entry.summary: Democrats' resounding victory in the midterms can be boiled down to frustrations over the high cost of living and gas prices. But in divided government -- how much can Democrats do?

entry.title: The incoming class of U.S. senators is full of historic firsts
entry.summary: From the first Native American woman elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates on Tuesday.

entry.title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
entry.summary: The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.

entry.title: Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff
entry.summary: The change comes after sweeping Republican losses in the midterm elections.

entry.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
entry.summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

entry.title: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
entry.summary: A judge has blocked construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval to proceed. And, the Labor Department is set to release the latest jobs report today, a day after stocks plunged.

entry.title: 'He's got to go': Hakeem Jeffries calls for Hegseth's removal but stops short of impeachment
entry.summary: Speaking with Morning Edition, Hakeem Jeffries discussed ending the Iran war, holding Trump accountable and calls for new Democratic leadership, but offered few specifics on how Democrats would deliver.
